_comment: Reference config for the Bedrock agent action group. Use these values when creating the action group via console, CLI, or IaC. The Lambda ARN is filled in after you deploy agent/lambda.

actionGroups.description: Draft contracts, raise risks, deep research, and produce reports.

mcpServers._comment: Box is reached via MCP. If your agent runtime supports MCP tool federation, register box/mcp_config.json here; otherwise the Lambda uses box/box_client.py directly.
